p: Reuben and the children of Gad: Reuben came from Leah, and Gad from Zilpah her handmaid.
Gilead: Which was named for the heap of stones that Jacob made as a sign of the covenant between him and Laban in Ge 31:47.
evil in the sight of the: Because they complained and would not believe their report, which told the truth concerning the land.
ye shall destroy all this people: By your occasion.
place: In the land of Canaan.
armed before the LORD to war: Before the Ark of the Lord.
enemies from before him: That is, the inhabitants of the land.
before the LORD: The Lord will grant you this land which you request, Jos 1:15.
will find you out: You shall assuredly be punished for your sin.
commanded Eleazar the priest: Moses gave charge that his promise made to the Reubenites, and other, would be performed after his death so that they would not break theirs.
LORD hath said unto thy servants: This is attributed to the Lord, which his messenger speaks.
Amorites: The Amorites dwelled on both sides of Jordan: but here he makes mention of them that dwelt on this side: Jos 10:12 he speaks of them that inhabited beyond Jordan.
Havothjair: That is the villages of Jair.
